Edit → Preferences: choose English or Français and customize keyboard shortcuts. Changes take effect when you save; no restart is required. The shortcuts below are the defaults.

TOOLS
Select: choose Vertices, Edges, or Faces. Use Move, Rotate, or Scale in the sidebar, either by dragging or by entering values. The pivot is at the center of the selection. Positive angles rotate counterclockwise. Shift snaps rotation to 15° increments. Negative scale factors mirror the selection.
Line styles: Solid, Long dashes, or Short dashes. Fill patterns: Solid, Stripes, or Dots.
Color: the 12 saved-color slots start empty. Use + in the color wheel to save a color; right-click a saved color to delete it. The eyedropper samples the visible plan and its reference image. Saved colors persist between sessions.
Text (T): place annotations and edit them in the sidebar, then choose Apply text.
Shapes (R): rectangles use two opposite corners; circles use a center and radius, with 3 to 128 vertices. Click twice or click and drag.
Stairs: Straight, L-shaped, U-shaped, or Spiral. Set the number of steps, width, turn direction, and spiral sweep angle. Outlines are solid; tread lines use long dashes. Each staircase is grouped automatically.
Ctrl+G groups the selection; Ctrl+Shift+G ungroups it. Click any member to select its group. Move offsets are retained during the session.

LEVELS
Page Up / Page Down: switch levels. Lower levels fade progressively with distance. Upper levels are hidden by default; H shows their thin red outlines. Delete this level removes its contents; Ctrl+Z restores them. Use the level panel to move a selection to another level. The three-quarter preview is read-only.

Esc first clears the selection or cancels the current drawing action. With nothing selected, Esc deactivates the current tool. Reference image settings and navigation hints appear when no tool is active.
